payload.claim: `survivor_finding`'s `HOST_FILED` prefix (`saffron/phases/review.py:56`) reads `"[host-filed criterion probe] "` for every host-filed survivor, including a wrong version's (review.py:756-759, unchanged by this diff). This test's own fixture shows the resulting claim literally: `'[host-filed criterion probe] t.py::a stayed green with the spec's wrong version ...'` — a Wrong version survivor mislabeled as a Criterion probe, two terms §4 keeps distinct. Before this diff an unanchored survivor never reached the PR body, so the mislabel was invisible outside `findings.json`; `anchored_blockers` now renders it in the Disagreements table the operator reads (`saffron/report/pr_body.py:377-379`), so the diff newly exposes a vocabulary error it did not introduce.
